headers.//: Hosting's default is max-age=3600 for everything, which cached the shell for an hour after each deploy — including flutter_service_worker.js, the one file whose whole job is to notice a new version. A hard reload could not fix it, because the worker update check is a separate fetch served from that same cache. These four have fixed names (Flutter does not hash them), so revalidation is the only way a client learns they changed.
